Jonas Brothers to Perform at NFL Season Opener in Melbourne

The NFL has announced that the American pop band Jonas Brothers will perform as the half-time entertainment for the upcoming NFL season opener. The game will be held in Melbourne, Australia, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG). This event marks the launch of the NFL season and will feature the teams Rams and 49ers. The performance is scheduled for September.
